remarks: Entry Foyer welcomes you to this one of a kind, open & airy corner condo with lovely sunset views. in one of Stamford's premier luxury, 24 hour doorman buildings. Spacious Living Room with Sliders and Hardwood Floors opens to Dining Room. Kitchen has loads of storage, stainless appliances & granite counters plus breakfast bar open to Dining Room. Here's the "WOW" - generous En-Suite Primary Bedroom with new wall to wall carpet, large Walk-In Closet and spacious Primary Bath with double shower, double sinks and walk-in linen closet. An additional well proportioned Bedroom, Full Hall Bath, in-unit Laundry and bonus Walk-In Hall Closet. Building features heated in-ground pool, grass courtyard, 2 gyms & library. Building updates include outside facade, walkways, windows, refurbished hallways, pool deck, enhanced landscaping, front entrance and more!! 1 reserved Garage spot (#79 on G2). Located in the heart of downtown close to restaurants, shopping theatres, commuting & train. Extras include electric shades, new ref and 1 year old diishwasher, washer & dryer.
